items.title: Trump beralih ke diesel Rusia menjelang pemilu paruh waktu, namun para analis melihat sedikit penurunan harga
items.summary: President Donald Trump's latest effort to ease a diesel supply crunch ahead of November's midterm elections is unlikely to make a dent on prices.

items.title: Intel dan CEO Broadcom memperingatkan krisis modal bisa menjadi hambatan terbesar bagi AI
items.summary: The CEOs of Intel and Broadcom warned that access to capital could emerge as a major constraint on the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: Dewan Ketenagakerjaan Bank Dunia mendesak dilakukannya langkah-langkah dukungan ketenagakerjaan di 'era krisis' sementara IMF memperingatkan akan adanya 'tsunami' AI
items.summary: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.
